mitigation_measures: avoid downloading .desktop or .directory files from untrusted sources
update to version 5.61.0 of KDE Frameworks 5
functionality: execute system commands to remove or manipulate files
related_malicious_code_snippet: When a .desktop or .directory file is instantiated, it unsafely evaluates environment variables and shell expansions using KConfigPrivate::expandString() via the KConfigGroup::readEntry() function.
